integrity: The proof is a complete symbolic split into primes, prime squares, and squarefree semiprimes. The attached finite computation is corroborative only and is not used to infer the unbounded statement.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to \(\Omega(n)\le2\). It does not classify composite solutions of larger multiplicity, including fixed two-prime supports with larger exponents.
title: No semiprime solutions to the Dujella–Luca congruence
